meta: Scale a recipe by number of people with AI: doubling a recipe can still taste off, because salt, water and cooking time don't scale evenly.

muc.title: Doubled and it tastes off
muc.text: Double a recipe and it can still taste off, because salt, water and cooking time don't scale evenly with the ingredients.

muc.title: Convert by servings
muc.text: Paste the recipe into a chatbot with the new number of servings, and ask it to recalculate each amount in spoons and bowls for easy measuring.

muc.title: Add seasoning gradually
muc.text: For salt, sugar and fish sauce, ask AI to list slightly less. Seasoning bit by bit and adding more later is easier.

muc.title: Watch for doneness
muc.text: A bigger pot changes the heat and time. Ask AI for the signs a dish is cooked through; don't just watch the clock.

muc.title: Four servings into two
muc.text: Take a familiar recipe for four people and ask AI to convert it for two.

thu: Take a familiar recipe for 4 people and ask AI to convert it for 2.
